newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close a shade lower in mixed trade.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close a shade lower in mixed trade.

text.p: Share prices on the Delhi Stock Exchange closed marginally lower as late buying by domestic mutual funds wiped off most of the early losses, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 0.75 points lower at 692.20. The index had dipped to 683.87 in early trade.
"Despite a minor recovery in share prices on fund buying, the overall trend remained weak as foreign institutional investors made heavy sales," said Rakesh Arora of brokers S.R. Mittal and company.

Brokers said shares of the tobacco company ITC, currently under investigation for alleged foreign exchange law violations, faced heavy selling and plunged 23.25 rupees, or 8.67 percent, to 245.0 rupees.
Reliance Industries dropped 0.20 rupee to 186.0, while State Bank of India was down 1.65 rupees to 214.70 on foreign selling, they said.
Larsen and Toubro dropped 1.80 rupees to 215.0 and Hindustan Lever slipped 4.0 rupees to 774.0.+
